descriptions.text: Fragmenting Potion Ball. A full potion vial may be transferred to this ball.

recap.text: Mordecai's last new item is a hardened rubber ball that splits open when Carl squeezes it. Pour in a potion and throw it, and the potion works on mobs, which as far as Mordecai can tell do not get potion sickness. The ball breaks if thrown too hard. Donut refuses to be lobbed at.

Carl stands on the wing of a diving plane, with Donut screaming at the stick, and loads a potion ball of Mordecai's Special Brew into his xistera. It should heal Orthrus at once and make him near-invulnerable for thirty seconds, if it lands before Quan's electrical attack. Carl throws with all his strength, and the ball hits as Quan attacks. The puppy glows and his health rockets to the top, but he does not wake.

In the hydra fight, Carl drops an invisibility potion, a potion ball holding a second invisibility potion for Mongo, and a handful of Good Healing potions on the ground, and tells Donut to drink when she can and watch where she steps. Donut picks up the dropped potion with her mouth, tosses her head back and drinks it. She then slaps the potion ball at Mongo, where it breaks against his leg and he disappears.

Two waves of colourful skulls, each about twenty feet tall, come at the truck from both sides of the road. One of the two ghouls riding outside it hurls potion balls holding Biscuit Packs, something like the Denial of Service missiles but much thicker. Each ball bursts into a foam blob about three metres across that hardens to rock in seconds. They pop one after another like popcorn, snagging dozens of skulls at a time and building a barrier.

beats.headline: A hard rubber ball
beats.text: The last of Mordecai's new items feels like a hardened rubber ball, and when Carl squeezes it, a split appears. The description is one line. Mordecai had to upgrade his table to three to make them; at five he can make them twice as fast, at six a hundred at a time. Pour in a potion and throw the ball. Nobody has to drink it: potions work on mobs if you throw them, and as far as Mordecai can tell, mobs do not get potion sickness. They break if thrown too hard, so never toss an armed one around unless it is at a bad guy. On another crawler he doubts it would work, and Donut refuses to be lobbed at; on Mongo it probably would.
beats.gist: Carl squeezes a rubber ball that splits open; Mordecai says you pour in a potion and throw it.

beats.headline: Special Brew, for a puppy
beats.text: Standing on the wing of a diving plane, with Donut screaming at the stick, Carl loads a potion ball filled with Mordecai's Special Brew into his xistera. It should heal Orthrus at once and make him near-invulnerable for thirty seconds, and Mordecai has confirmed it will work on the dog; Carl just has to hit him before Quan gets close enough for his electrical attack. He puts all his strength into the throw. The ball hits the puppy at the same moment Quan attacks. The dog glows and his health rockets to the top. It does not wake him up.
beats.gist: Carl hits Orthrus with Mordecai's Special Brew as Quan attacks; his health maxes out, but he stays asleep.

beats.headline: Invisible Mongo
beats.text: In the hydra fight Carl drops an invisibility potion, a potion ball holding another invisibility potion for Mongo, and a handful of Good Healing potions on the ground, and tells Donut to drink when she can and watch where she steps. Further into the fight she picks up the dropped potion with her mouth, tosses her head back and drinks it, then slaps the potion ball at Mongo. It breaks against his leg, and he disappears.
beats.gist: Carl leaves potions on the ground; Donut drinks one, then slaps a potion ball at Mongo, who vanishes.

beats.headline: Biscuit Packs
beats.text: Two waves of colourful skulls, each about twenty feet tall, come at the truck from both sides of the road, and one of the two ghouls riding outside the truck starts hurling his potion balls at them. These hold Biscuit Packs, something like the Denial of Service missiles but much thicker. Each ball bursts into a round foam blob about three metres across that hardens in seconds to the consistency of rock. They pop one after another, popcorn-like, snagging dozens of skulls at a time and building a barrier as they go.
beats.gist: Two skull waves close on the truck, and a ghoul hurls potion balls that burst into rock-hard foam.
